messages:
emily (support): FYI — customer 'Bluefjord' completed SSO onboarding but says they have no usable API key. Console shows a key row, but their calls return 403. Customer email: ops@bluefjord.com, project id: pf-7a3d. Can someone check the provisioner?

jordan (provisioning): Got it. Do you have the tenant/org ID or the console request id? Any customer-provided request log from their side?

emily (support): Customer pasted this when calling the /v1/generate endpoint: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_********" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"hi"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"project_not_authorized","message":"API key not bound to project pf-7a3d"}
```

And their console screenshot shows a key row with status "Provisioned" but project column empty.

onboard-bot: Provision job 2026-03-15T17:22:11Z (job-id: prov-9c3f) completed. Claim token resolved to tenant id tnt-00421. Bound project: internal-test-238. (logs: https://internal/prov/2026/prov-9c3f)

jordan (provisioning): Hmm — that explains it. Claim token tnt-00421 was incorrectly routed to internal-test-238 (staging). Looks like a slug collision: incoming org slug 'bluefjord' matched a staging org with same slug. I will rebind the claim to pf-7a3d-prod and create a new key. Performing manual rebind now.

jordan (provisioning): Running: `provisioner rebind --claim prov-9c3f --target-project pf-7a3d-prod --force`

onboard-bot: Rebind started for prov-9c3f. Previous binding: internal-test-238. New binding: pf-7a3d-prod. Key generation queued.

maria (sre): FYI we've seen a race in the async claim handler where two orgs share slug after mid-flight name change; retry logic sometimes picks the first match. We should add a slug+tenant-id check to avoid this.

jordan (provisioning): New key created and attached: sk_live_bfj_1a2b3c (partial). Propagating to console and KMS. I've emailed ops@bluefjord.com with the new key and asked them to retry. Propagation ETA ~45s.

emily (support): Customer reports they retried and now the call returns 200. They confirmed the key in console shows project pf-7a3d-prod.

liz (devex): I'll add a short note to the onboarding troubleshooting doc about slug uniqueness and also add a cross-check step in the provisioner UI to show tenant id next to slug.

emily (support): Closing on our side. Follow-up ticket for dev: PROV-1426 to add slug+tenant validation + UI cross-check. :thumbsup:
